paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 1.92 as of 2026-11-20, with a decrease of 7.04% from the prior close and 34.86% over the last 24 sessions. There have been 3 new news articles in the last 24 hours.

These articles were published by the Amarillo Tribune, Quantisnow, and Seeking Alpha on MSN.
